intro:
The Green Knight after his return (see `art-tools/green_knight_parts/POSES.md`): the same armour and props, his helm gone, his bare head the one the owner's first sheet drew (`art-tools/green_knight_parts/sources/bare_head_ref.png`), with a healed scar on his neck where the blow landed. The game swaps to this puppet when he comes back. He returns once, so C6 is his entrance and D6 his last exit.

howto: One fresh ChatGPT chat for all five (there is no new character sheet). The first prompt (pose sheet A) attaches THREE images: the Green Knight's helmed character sheet, the bare-head sheet (`art-tools/green_knight_parts/sources/bare_head_ref.png`, the owner's first try: its heads only), and Washington's pose sheet A for the style. From the second prompt on, attach the helmed character sheet, the bare-head sheet, this set's pose sheet A once it exists, AND Washington's pose sheet A.
character: (no new character sheet: this set reuses the helmed one and the bare-head sheet)

A: At rest: both forearms lying along the table's edge, his gauntlets resting on the felt in front of him, a hand's width apart, relaxed and NOT touching, NOT laced, NOT overlapping; the holly branch behind his right shoulder; the axe head on the table's edge by his right hand; bareheaded, a big friendly grin, mouth closed
Peeking at his cards: his right hand cupped over two cards on the felt, thumb lifting the near corner, eyes down
Checking: one big finger of his right hand tapping the felt
Calling: his right hand sliding a short stack of chips forward
Betting: his right hand shoving a stack of chips well forward
Folding: his right hand tossing two cards away face down, with a shrug
B: All in: both huge hands pushing his whole stack of chips forward, leaning in
Showing: his right hand turning two cards face up; the card faces are BLANK white, no ranks, no suits
Collecting the pot: both forearms out on the felt, scooping a pile of chips in
The holly branch behind his shoulder rustling: leaves shaking, berries bouncing, a few motion lines; he does not touch it; arms as at rest
Looking down at his left forearm, where a little green moss is creeping along the plate, amused; arms as at rest
Laughing a huge laugh: head thrown back, mouth wide, shoulders shaking; arms as at rest
C: A broad grin at nobody in particular; arms as at rest
Running the thumb of his right gauntlet along the edge of the axe head on the table, slowly
His right hand held flat above the table, measuring it, as if for a blow, one eye narrowed
Glancing toward a door over his left shoulder, as if hearing his horse stamp outside; arms as at rest
Shifting his great weight in his seat, one shoulder dipped, a sheepish grin; arms as at rest
Just arrived back, bareheaded: both arms thrown wide above the table, laughing, a gust of holly leaves blowing round him, the healed scar on his neck showing
D: Talking: his right gauntlet open, booming
Facing a big bet: a delighted grin, eyes narrowed, a challenge accepted; arms as at rest
Lost a pot: laughing, his right hand slapping the table
Won a pot: beaming, his right hand scooping a few chips toward him
Down to two players: leaning in on both forearms, eyes bright and eager
Knocked out for good: rising from his seat, the axe on his shoulder, a deep laughing bow

face:
Character sheet for 2D animation rigging: the bareheaded Green Knight's face overlays, exactly matching the attached sheets' style, colours and line weight.

Every piece is drawn at EXACTLY the angle and size of his bare head in the at-rest pose of the attached pose sheet (three-quarter, facing the viewer's right), so each one can be laid over that head. Draw that head once, top left, with its neck (the healed scar), the green hair, the beard and the top of the armour, as the reference, mouth closed, WITHOUT the holly. Then every piece separate, with a closed dark outline and a wide gap all round it; nothing touches. Pure white background (#FFFFFF). No text, no labels.

- His eyes with the lids half closed; closed; looking toward the viewer; looking down at the table; looking to the side, toward a door; narrowed, delighted (one piece each, both eyes with the green skin around them)
- His brows raised; his brows drawn down (one piece each, both brows)
- Lower-face patches, each the mouth with the moustache and only the TOP of the beard around it, cut straight across just under the nose and again a little below the lower lip: closed in a grin; open "ah"; wide "ee"; round "oh"; pursed "oo"; lips pressed "m"; lower lip under the teeth "f"; tongue tip behind the teeth "l"; a huge laugh, mouth wide; a broad toothy grin
- His head turned toward the viewer, nearly front-on
